links.outcome: Macro kappa of zero-shot LLM versus simpler supervised classifier on the same data
links.effect: Zero-shot LLM macro kappa 0.139 (95% CI 0.111-0.164) vs supervised classifier 0.227 (0.186-0.262); paired improvement 0.088 (0.051-0.119); stack 0.242.
links.quote: The supervised classifier reached kappa = 0.227 (0.186-0.262), a paired improvement of 0.088 (0.051-0.119).

links.outcome: Sensitivity of reported performance to data splitting unit and leakage of labeled exemplars
links.effect: Multiple leakage paths identified (sibling recordings split separately, held-out patient labels entering few-shot exemplars); performance sensitive to splitting unit and exemplar placement. No leakage effect numbers reported in abstract.
links.quote: Reported performance is sensitive to the unit of data splitting and to where labeled exemplars enter the pipeline.

unlisted_practices: Patient-grouped nested cross-validation with inner cross-fitted thresholds
Grouping sibling recordings together to prevent leakage
Computing few-shot exemplars inside the outer evaluation loop

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM and supervised classification on real clinical encounter transcripts to detect shared decision-making behaviors, specifically testing the methodological safeguard of data leakage control and patient-level grouping during validation.

primary.practice: evaluation leakage control and patient-level grouping
